name: prestashopheaven/build-typescript
description: The shared TypeScript and JavaScript tooling of the PrestaHaven modules: tsconfig base, PrestaShop typings (admin and front), the _dev build (typecheck, lint, tests with 100 % coverage, esbuild bundle, build manifest), the ESLint and Vitest configs and the base npm dependencies.

prestashopheaven.use-when: A module has JavaScript or TypeScript in _dev/ (recipe typescript or js-tests): extend the tsconfig base, include the PrestaShop typings and call the shared build, ESLint and Vitest configs from the module's _dev files.
